answered.sql: SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.LastName FROM ChefRestaurants AS T1 JOIN Chefs AS T2 ON T1.ChefID = T2.ChefID JOIN Languages AS T3 ON T2.LanguageID = T3.LanguageID WHERE T3.LanguageName = 'English' UNION SELECT T5.FirstName, T5.LastName FROM ServerRestaurants AS T4 JOIN Servers AS T5 ON T4.ServerID = T5.ServerID JOIN Languages AS T6 ON T5.LanguageID = T6.LanguageID WHERE T6.LanguageName = 'English'

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who speak English.
candidates.sql: SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName, S.FirstName, S.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN Languages L ON C.LanguageID = L.LanguageID JOIN ServerRestaurants SR ON C.ChefID = SR.ServerID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English' UNION SELECT C.FirstName, C.LastName, S.FirstName, S.LastName FROM Chefs C JOIN Languages L ON C.LanguageID = L.LanguageID JOIN ChefRestaurants CR ON C.ChefID = CR.ChefID WHERE L.LanguageName = 'English'

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers whose primary language is English.
candidates.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Chefs WHERE LanguageID = (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English') UNION SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Servers WHERE LanguageID = (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English')

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who are capable of speaking English, regardless of it being their primary language.
candidates.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Chefs WHERE LanguageID IN (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English') UNION SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Servers WHERE LanguageID IN (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English')

candidates.meaning: Show the chefs and servers who are employed at restaurants where English is spoken.
candidates.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Chefs WHERE ChefID IN (SELECT ChefID FROM ChefRestaurants) UNION SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Servers WHERE ServerID IN (SELECT ServerID FROM ServerRestaurants) AND LanguageID = (SELECT LanguageID FROM Languages WHERE LanguageName = 'English')
